query:
SELECT pi.id, pi.url, pi.caption, pc.slug 
FROM portfolio_images pi
JOIN portfolio_categories pc ON pi.category_id = pc.id
WHERE pc.slug = 'profissional'
ORDER BY pi.sort_order, pi.id
LIMIT 20;
